title: terminal.output payload
description: One chunk of PTY output pushed to the terminal pane. This is the server->client stream message, not the stored event itself: the terminal.output event carries its own server-assigned idempotency_key (ADR-0008) independently of this push, so the envelope's idempotency_key is optional/nullable for this type too (a sender may echo the event's key here for client-side dedup, but the contract does not require it). Shape mirrors contracts/schemas/events/payloads/terminal.output/1.json (data + encoding): the terminal bridge pushes the exact bytes it also stores as the terminal.output event's payload. 'encoding' is 'utf-8' unless this chunk splits a multibyte UTF-8 sequence at its boundary, in which case it is 'base64' (a PTY streams raw bytes with no regard for UTF-8 boundaries, unlike learner keystroke input; see contracts/schemas/websocket/README.md). 'sequence' matches the stored event's payload.sequence, letting the client detect gaps or duplicates across a reconnect.

sequence.description: Display order within one terminal, shared with terminal.input-derived commands.
